lines.zh: 我的翅膀在海风里展开
lines.en: My wings open in the sea wind.

lines.zh: 我一振翅，沙滩就退到脚下
lines.en: One beat and the beach is below me.

lines.zh: 我从崖边飞出去，又升起来
lines.en: I launch from the cliff and climb again.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙滩上一掠而过
lines.en: My shadow sweeps across the sand.
I beat steadily; the wind carries me.
I fly just above the wave crests.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，回到山那边
lines.en: I turn half around toward the mountain.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很薄，声音很轻
lines.en: My wings are thin and quiet.
I look down as I fly.
The glare off the sea stings.
I settle on a ledge of the cliff.

lines.zh: 我沿着崖壁的气流上升
lines.en: I climb on the cliff's updraught.

lines.zh: 我从浪里叼起什么，又扔了
lines.en: I snatch something from a wave and drop it.
I turn inland; the mountains are there.
I stand on the cliff with wings folded.
Sea wind ruffles my feathers.
Waves break far below.

lines.zh: 我在看海面有没有动静
lines.en: I am watching the water for movement.

lines.zh: 我站在岩尖上，翼膜半张。
lines.en: I stand on a rock point, membranes half spread.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚换了个位置
lines.en: I move one foot.

lines.zh: 岩壁上有一块我常用的地方
lines.en: There is a spot on this cliff I always use.
I wipe my beak on my wing.
No one on the beach below.

lines.zh: 我张了张翅膀，又收回去
lines.en: I open my wings and fold them.
The waves push in, layer by layer.
I stand on one foot.
The sea wind tastes of salt.
I turn my head inland.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，隔着一段高度
lines.en: I look down at you from a height.
You stand out on the beach.
I spread my wings and do not fly.
Wind passes under my wings.

lines.zh: 我不太怕人，我只是不熟
lines.en: I am not much afraid; only unused to you.

lines.zh: 我一个眼睛盯着你，头冠迎风。
lines.en: One eye on you, my crest into the wind.
I glide a stretch down the cliff.

lines.zh: 你在石头上，我看得很清
lines.en: You are on the rocks; I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我停在你头顶那股风里
lines.en: I hover in the wind above you.
You raise a hand and I rise.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我的叫声很难听
lines.en: I do not call; my call is ugly.

lines.zh: 我落在一块更近的崖上
lines.en: I settle on a nearer ledge.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一歪，往下掉了一截
lines.en: My wing tilts and I drop a stretch.
I land on the cliff and fold quickly.

lines.zh: 我的一边翅膀不太听话
lines.en: One wing will not quite obey.
It takes several beats to climb.
I land, wings dragging.
One wing beats slower.
I hop twice on the sand.
I fold my wings very tight.
There is blood on my beak.
I lift my head, breathing fast.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我看得清
lines.en: I can see what is in your hand.
Up here I cannot smell it.
I glide down a stretch.

lines.zh: 我落在一块石头上，离你不远
lines.en: I land on a stone, not far from you.
I will not land; I will wait up here.
Hold it up.

lines.zh: 我落在沙滩上，离你几步
lines.en: I land on the sand, a few steps off.
I extend my head, slowly.
I will peck once and go.
This does not look like fish.
We strike in midair.

lines.zh: 翼尖擦过你的肩膀，很轻。
lines.en: My wingtip brushed your shoulder, lightly.
I flip once before steadying.
You reach up and I shoot higher.

lines.zh: 我被撞得落在一块石头上
lines.en: The impact drops me onto a stone.
We collide and I come down.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀把你的帽子掀了
lines.en: My wing knocks your hat off.
You knock me off course.
I skid a short way on the sand.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的肩上，又飞开
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and leave.
She flies a layer above me.
We glide down the sea wind together.
Her wings are a little narrower.
She settles beside me and folds her wings.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在沙上并着
lines.en: Our shadows lie side by side on the sand.
She flies steadier than I do.
We rest on the cliff together.
She smooths my wings.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后掠过海面
lines.en: We skim the sea, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我们同时起飞，同时转向
lines.en: We take off and turn as one.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，落在它旁边
lines.en: I drop down beside it.
I take it in my beak; it is unsteady.
I pin it under a forefoot.
I take off again and it falls.
I flick it up with my beak.
Too heavy to lift.
I drop it and watch it fall.
I dig twice in the sand.

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住，低头叼起。
lines.en: I pin it with a claw and dip my head.
I nudge it aside with my beak.
I stop in the air, wings locked.
I drop altitude, coming down slowly.
You are on the sand below me.
The wind shifts and I shift with it.
I hold still in the air.
I lower myself a little.
My shadow falls on you.
The sea wind comes from your side.
I check my wings.
I turn to face you directly.

lines.zh: 我落在一块靠你的石上
lines.en: I settle on a stone near you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀半开，随时能走
lines.en: My wings half open, ready to leave.
If you move, I will watch a while longer.

lines.zh: 我不怕在这个高度上被追
lines.en: I am safe from pursuit at this height.

lines.zh: 我借海风升到你的头顶。
lines.en: I ride the sea wind above your head.
You look up and I climb.
I hold this height.
My shadow circles your feet.
I draw circles around you.
Each pass is lower.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，我在侧面
lines.en: You look up; I am at your flank.
I fly along the cliff, the wind steady.
I stay airborne; it is fastest.

lines.zh: 我的影子始终落在你身上
lines.en: My shadow stays on you the whole time.
You reach the water; I follow.
The sea wind carries me past the cliff.

lines.zh: 海风把我的方向压住了
lines.en: The sea wind holds my line.

lines.zh: 我在你上方那层气流里
lines.en: I ride the air a layer above you.

lines.zh: 你走到崖下，我绕到崖上
lines.en: You reach the cliff base; I circle the top.

lines.zh: 我从不落在你够得着的地方
lines.en: I never land within your reach.
My circles close in smaller and smaller.
I dive, claws first.
My wing beats your face.
I strike and climb back up.
I peck once.
I dive, beak forward.
My talons rake across your shoulder.
My wing strikes your ear.
I peck once and fly off.

lines.zh: 我的长喙啄向你的后颈。
lines.en: My long beak stabs at your nape.
I miss and land on a stone.
My beak scrapes your hand.
My second pass comes in lower.
You raise a hand; I pass on the side.
I fly close past your back.
I sweep in from the side.

lines.zh: 我在你的肩上一踩就走
lines.en: I push off your shoulder and go.
A shadow appears on the cliff first.
I spread my wings and the wind fills them.
I leap off the cliff.
The sea wind lifts me.
I circle the cliff half way.

lines.zh: 沙滩上多了一片会动的影子
lines.en: A moving shadow is added to the beach.
I slide out from the cliff's mouth.
My wings open and the sea wind comes.
I stop above the beach.

lines.zh: 海面的光反到我翅膀上
lines.en: The sea's glare reflects on my wings.

lines.zh: 我绕着这一片崖飞了一圈
lines.en: I circle this stretch of cliff once.
My shadow lands on the sand first.

lines.zh: 我落到一块突出的岩石上
lines.en: I settle on a jutting rock.
I call once and head inland.
The wind fills my wings.
I come from the mountain side.

lines.zh: 热气把我的翅膀烤得发软
lines.en: The heat softens my wings.
I lose the wind and fall.

lines.zh: 海水打湿我的翅膀，我游不快
lines.en: Seawater soaks my wings and I swim poorly.
The blast spins me over.

lines.zh: 翼膜破了个洞，我飞歪了。
lines.en: A hole tears my membrane; I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的翅膀僵了一下
lines.en: That force stiffens my wings.
Long hungry, my wingbeats wander.

lines.zh: 雷光把海面照白，我闭上了眼
lines.en: Lightning whitens the sea and I shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 身下的海没有了，我一直在落
lines.en: The sea below is gone; I keep falling.
